response.text:
Tapai ko NPR account ma **NPR 45,000** matra chha — ek lakh pathauna pugdaina.

Ra NPR bata NPR (same currency) corridor ma kunei provider active chhaina, tyasaile fee/rate nikalna sakidaina.

Ke garnu hunchha?
- QAR bata pathaune ho? (QAR 3,800 chha) — bhanidinu, ma quote herchu.
- Ya NPR account ma paisa thapnu parne ho?

Fee paanch hajar bhanda kam hunchha ki hunna bhanne kura provider anusar farak parcha — tapai le kun currency bata pathaune ho bhanne nishchit garnus, ani ma pakka bhandinchu.
